name: Nihon Kagaku Sangyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Nihon Kagaku Sangyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals and building materials in Japan and internationally. It offers various inorganic metal products, including copper, tin, nickel, cobalt, bismuth, chromium, manganese, antimony, zinc, iron, and lithium compounds; organic metal compounds, such as metal acetylacetonate, metallic soaps, PUCAT, and PA series products; surface treatment agents; and other compounds. The company's chemical products are used in various industries, such as optical/precision instruments, electronics, ceramics, petrochemical catalysis, healthcare, and battery materials.
